title: State the M365 source-document controller boundary in the customer DPA
description:
## Action

Add wording to the customer **DPA** stating the M365 source-document controller boundary.

## Why

From KS-234 §5.3: Secuura's m365 integration holds only an **org-scoped OAuth connection** (`svc_m365_connections`), not a per-user copy of source documents. The source documents live in the **customer's own M365 / SharePoint tenant**, where the **customer is the data controller**. On a Secuura erasure, the customer's M365 source is therefore the **customer's** erasure responsibility, not Secuura's.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Customer DPA explicitly states the customer is controller of their own M365 source documents and is responsible for erasing them in their own tenant.

Refs: KS-234 §5.3. (Belongs in the DPA legal doc, not the platform repo.)
